_about: Consultation flow, native Squarespace: step 1 is a page of seven links, step 2 is one page per situation each with its own Form block, step 3 is the form's post-submit message or redirect. The form on these mockup pages is visible but does not submit; its button opens the confirmation page.
confirm: Page copy: 'What do you need help with?', 'Step 1 of 2' / 'Step 2 of 2', 'Change', 'Send my request', the seven choice cards (six are the home page situation cards verbatim; 'Something else.' and its line are new)

Disclaimer under every form: "Sending this form does not create an attorney-client relationship. Please don't include confidential details." (new wording; the live site's disclaimer page says the site does not create a lawyer-client relationship)

Contact fields on every form: Name, Phone, Email, 'How should we reach you?' (Call / Email), 'How soon do you need help?' (There's a deadline / In the next month / Just planning ahead), 'Anything else we should know?'; Name and Email and the contact method are marked required
The native Squarespace form block cannot show or hide questions, so each situation has its own page with its own form; the step-2 pages carry no confidential-case fields
Questions on this page: Which state did you move from? [text]; Do you have an existing will or trust? [Yes / No / Not sure]
